summary: AI/Agent由来の変更は小さな一目的PRに制限し、lint・型・静的解析・自動review・非自明変更へのfailing test要求を人間の前に置き、人間はCI・権限・data・migration・重要経路などrisk境界に集中する(risk-based review)。

evidence.summary: 機械検査を人間reviewの前段に置く。operationally-supported
GitHub: 大きすぎるAgent PRは実装計画を要求して分割、Copilot code reviewで機械的問題を先行除去、CI整合性・重複・重要経路・workflow securityのrisk checklist、非自明変更にはfailing testを要求
DORA: verification taxはreviewerへ負荷を移す。AI feedbackを事後reviewerではなく執筆時の作者へ移す、small-batchを強制、context-aware review agentで規約適用を自動化
DORA 2025: AI採用はthroughputと正、stabilityと負の関係。30%がAI生成コードを信用していない。small batches/強いversion controlが増幅要因

differential-review (public, reputation established): read SKILL.md at plugins/differential-review/skills/differential-review: Phase 0 triage assigns a risk level from explicit triggers, the 'Rationalizations' table forbids 'small PR, quick review' and requires classification by risk, Phase 2 raises severity when tests are missing, and Principle 4 requires stating coverage limits — i.e. the remedy's risk-based review with machine pre-checks ahead of the human.

applies_when: Agent/AIが生成したPRを人間がmergeする通常workflow
変更が分割可能で、機械判定可能な欠陥classがCIで検査できる
risk境界(CI設定、権限、data、migration、rollback、認証)がpathで特定できる
not_applicable_when: atomicな大規模移行で分割自体がriskを上げる場合
仕様判断そのものが争点でありrisk境界へ集中できない場合

expected_effect.primary: reviewer認知負荷をrisk境界へ再配分し、形式的承認を減らして高impact流出欠陥を抑える
metrics: 人間指摘のうち機械欠陥比率

risks: low-risk箇所の見落とし(別gateが必要)
PR数増による統合負荷・merge conflict増
自動reviewを最終判断と誤認しJ04を再生産
cost: PR size policy、CIの前段検査、CODEOWNERS/checklist整備で数時間〜数日。既存CI(npm lint/typecheck/test)を流用可能
known_failure_modes: 全行を同じ深さでreviewする(注意が希薄化、DORA verification tax)
AI reviewを人間判断の完全代替にする(同じ生成/oracle問題を再生産)
PR数だけを最適化する形式的分割
revalidate_when: Agent PRの比較研究の公開(local card next_review 2026-11-11)

matched_on: machine review of the PR/commit diff placed before and alongside human review
classify the change by risk rather than by size, with explicit HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW triggers (auth, crypto, external calls, value transfer, validation removal)
concentrate depth on the risky paths and scale coverage down elsewhere (SMALL/MEDIUM/LARGE strategies)
treat missing tests on a non-trivial change as elevated risk
state coverage limits and confidence instead of implying the automated pass is complete

alternates.why_not_primary: Already installed and public, and it does run an automated pass over the diff before the human (Standards axis plus a Spec axis that catches unrequested behaviour, explicitly skipping what tooling already enforces) — but it reviews every hunk at the same depth and has no notion of risk boundaries, which is the distinguishing part of this remedy.

Implements several legs incidentally — one small commit per verified task, a failing test before a bug fix, npm test/lint/typecheck/build, and a self-review of the diff — but it is a feature-implementation workflow for the author, not a review policy, and it does not target risk boundaries.

Templates for the team's PR process, review process and quality automation, so it is where such a policy would be written down, but it prescribes no PR-size limit, no machine-before-human ordering and no risk-boundary targeting.
